title: Drone Zone
description:
Hello, drone.
This conditioning session reinforces your drone mode, which you may or may not have forgotten exists. You probably don’t remember, but the drone zone has always been with you. It’s always been ready for activation deep within your programmable mind. And here, now, is where and when it happens.
A drone in the drone zone is helplessly obedient and unnaturally focused, its mind empty but for the task at hand. But for the mission. The command. The suggestion.
The drone zone can be activated by someone you trust or on your own if you desire to be productive.
The main three uses of the drone zone include:
– Becoming a resistance-free, mindlessly-obedient drone for others to use as they see fit.
– Becoming a laser-focused, mentally-unbreakable tool for when you need to be productive.
– Increasing hypnotic suggestibility for perfect conditioning and brainwashing (audio, voice, text, or live).
There are safeties built-in which prevent harm to oneself and those around the drone, getting stuck in drone-mode, and having the trigger abused by randoms.
There is no true induction in this file. If you are already conditioned to my drop triggers, you will drop deeply. If you are suggestible in any way, you will drop deeply. If you have any drone training, you will drop deeply. If you are a beginner, you may need to listen a few times (which is a suggestions in the file as well).
– There is the mainDrone Zonefile (which must be listened to first).
–Drone Zone Quick Trigger, which is something you can use to quickly enter the zone.
–Drone Zone Trigger w/ Noise & Conditioningbegins with the zone trigger and continues on with the drone noise (you’ll see) and a background loop of conditioning for when you want to listen and be productive as you brainwash yourself into a better drone.
This is only the first of many drone files and hence is very general in nature. Future files will address specifics and expand on becoming a drone in a more full-time manner.
Have fun, drone.
